observed_parent_stop: All 48 registered pair grids returned no_supported_identity_rank before graph construction.
purpose: Distinguish a sample-limited local-frame failure from failure of the between-class subcondition object itself by increasing samples through target-blind context pooling.
claim_boundary: This diagnostic may show that a global behavior-family object is statistically recoverable when contexts are integrated. It cannot establish a local bundle, transport, holonomy, causal edit value, VPD efficacy, compactification, recursive improvement, or RSI. Pooled objects cannot receive lineage_certified or holonomy_clean status.

support_curve.windows: all eight cyclic starts for pool sizes 1, 2, and 4; one full window for pool size 8
support_curve.pool_size_1_source: reuse the already sealed local-node receipts rather than recompute
support_curve.interpretation: Descriptive sample-support curve; only the full eight-shard pool controls the branch decision.

branch_decision.advance_to_denser_local_capture: For at least one base-to-adapter pair, the common full-pool passing cells contain at least three distinct sites and two distinct families.
branch_decision.stop_between_class_local_capture: No registered base-to-adapter pair meets the advance criterion.
branch_decision.advance_effect: Register a new capture with more prompt replicas per subcondition per local context; do not infer loops from pooled bases.
branch_decision.stop_effect: Do not spend additional GPU on this between-class subcondition object. Any alternative object requires a separately frozen protocol and cannot reuse this diagnostic as confirmatory evidence.

negative_control: The existing label-permutation upper-95 comparison remains mandatory at every rank and pool window.
